title: Not very absorbent
text:
Not very absorbent. These are very lovely, neutral, on trend kitchen towels. They feel thick and durable, though I don’t find them to be particularly absorbent. Water just sort beads up on them. I like them for the look but they are also sort of rough feeling.

I would consider these to be more decorative than functional.
